properties: Partial failure leaves recoverable state; removal cannot target another checkout; hooks run only at valid stages
assessment: real filesystem/Git cleanup/hook failure evidence and exact target checks
remaining: Native Git/filesystem/hook execution is required; shared-operation examples are bounded integration evidence, not all concurrent worktree schedules.
evidenceDecision: Real worktree/hook tests exercise fetch-before-create, failed fetch, one in-flight removal and retry after failure. WorktreeLifecycleDialog.test.ts replaces HostsFilter resource policy cases for retirement/disposal during an open, closed-target refresh/retry and failed validation, plus the live remembered-target retry count. The actual dialog and requestWorkspaceInspector run on controlled time with deliberately unfenced synthetic operational/service ports and an explicit admission-result receiver. This proves dialog cancellation and target-cache policy, not RPC lease composition or real Inspector publication. Files/Changes routes, rejection rendering/focus, browser file input/download lifecycle and qualified UI wiring remain mandatory in HostsFilter.resources.test.ts; existing store and runtime-lease consumers remain required. Roamgate web sync through 2b16e991 (PR3): command-template tests pass hostile values through a real sh, refuse quoted placeholders and invalid branch names, and cover SSH execution, the install probe and remove-command recovery. Settings tests keep global and per-repository commands, and Ranger's preview binds the displayed location and command, so a change blocks dispatch. A browser consumer shows the navigator's worktree actions at desktop and phone widths and leaves a stale host inert.
